
### Imports
```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pysrf
```


### Loading in similarity matrix
```{python}
similarity_npz = 'computed_similarity.npz'
S = np.load(f"../../data/{similarity_npz}")
```


### Applying SRF to similarity matrix
```{python}
rank = pysrf.estimate_rank(S, k_max=30)["k_star"] 
```
